description: List the sweeps in your workspace. A sweep runs one standard test once per caller persona: each has an id, name, description, testConfigId (the test) and profileIds (the personas). Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks what sweeps exist or names one. Name the test with getTestConfig and the personas with listProfiles. For a sweep's runs use listSweepRuns. Read-only. Needs testing:read.
name: listSweeps

items.description:
A sweep runs a single `TestConfig` across multiple profiles (personas). Useful for
regression-testing the same call flow with different caller personas.

profileIds.description: Profile IDs to sweep through (one run per profile).

testConfigId.description: The single TestConfig to run against each profile.

title: List Test Sweeps
